open_text_result: No project-compatible open transcription of the 11-word verse and title was found. The ancient evidence is identified precisely: Varro, De re rustica 1.1.9, names Menecrates of Ephesus as an agricultural poet, while the lexicographic witness preserves the single hexameter under a book of Erga. The current canonical SH 543–544 edition is copyrighted; it was not copied from an unauthorized web reproduction.

notes: The title is conventionally reconstructed as Erga from Varro’s agricultural-poetry notice; the verse is preserved through lexicographic transmission. The official SH landing page confirms Menecrates Ephesius at pp.269–270 but does not clear the modern edition. The related Diels catalog record reports 13 words and pp.171–172, a small discrepancy from the Canon’s 11-word extraction that must be checked from admissible images.
